target_customer: Satellite operators in LEO across commercial, federal and defense markets
problem: LEO satellites can only downlink data when passing over sparse ground stations, causing long delays; Apolink plans an always-on relay in orbit.
business_model: Data relay as a service sold to satellite operators, also resold through partners

founders.name: Onkar Singh Batra
previous_startups: InQube, described by TechCrunch as India's first open source satellite (2022)
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says he was 19 at the time of the July 2025 article, so age at founding in 2024 is not stated; stored value reflects the article date. No university degree mentioned.

competitors.name: Kepler Communications
competitors.what: Optical inter-satellite data relay network in LEO
competitors.traction_then: Validated optical inter-satellite links between two pathfinders in June 2024

competitors.name: Skyloom
competitors.what: Optical relay nodes in geostationary orbit for LEO constellations
competitors.traction_then: Partnered with Kepler on an Axiom Space optical link demo in December 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Hybrid RF and optical inter-satellite links, satellite hardware and launches are hardware and regulatory heavy for a seven person team.

defensibility.rationale: Orbital assets, spectrum rights and customer commitments are hard to replicate once deployed, but Kepler and megaconstellations are ahead.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: TechCrunch notes Starlink and Kuiper are also building inter-satellite links; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Growth in LEO satellite fleets and limited ground station coverage creating delays; the company claims 150 million dollars in customer commitments since 2024 per a January 2026 report (unverified summary).

branding.name_origin: Combination of apogee and link, per TechCrunch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission focused: 'Apolink keeps them connected, always', 'Join the mission'

rebrands.why: Reason not found; the date of the rename is not stated by the sources.

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is new, covered mainly as a teen founder story; no merch or brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Apolink raised a 4.3 million dollar seed at a reported 45 million dollar post-money in July 2025 and signed a relay reselling partnership with RBC Signals in January 2026, with a demo cubesat planned for 2026. The company is early and hardware dependent, so the outcome is open; it faces Kepler and the megaconstellations.
notes: CB Insights lists 10.8 million total raised under Bifrost Orbital, unverified and conflicting. A Bifrost profile lists Geffen Avraham as co-founder and CTO, but the YC page lists only Onkar Batra, so he is not recorded as a founder. The site footer names OrbitalNerds Inc. as copyright holder. Age at founding is not stated by the source.
